subject.title: bug(cost): mid-session writes to bootstrap-injected files trigger cacheWrite spiral on long agentic sessions; bootstrap-cache.ts shipped for #43532 is content-equality, not session-freeze

question: Should OpenClaw keep bootstrap prompt context live per turn, add an opt-in session-freeze mode, or let operators classify volatile bootstrap files below the cache boundary?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but resolving it creates a durable prompt-cache/config contract and may change existing expectations about live workspace-file visibility.

options.title: Add opt-in session freeze
options.body: Add a documented session-stable bootstrap prompt mode with live file-tool reads and unchanged default behavior.

options.title: Use dynamic file config
options.body: Implement bootstrapDynamicFiles/bootstrapFileOrder under the existing dynamic-file tracker and document volatile-file placement.

options.title: Keep live refresh
options.body: Leave current live refresh behavior intact and update docs/model guidance to warn operators about cacheWrite cost.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in session freeze
recommendation.body: Add a documented session-stable bootstrap prompt mode with live file-tool reads and unchanged default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best available owner because his history covers the original bootstrap snapshot cache and the earlier session-freeze closure.
